description: This file defines a set of static debug actions for a macOS application, including functions to open windows and files, restart services, send notifications, toggle logging, perform health checks, manage SSH tunnels, and handle session data. It centralizes various UI actions and debugging utilities for the OpenClaw macOS app.

classes.name: DebugActionError
classes.description: An error type for debug actions, encapsulating message-based errors.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a window displaying agent events using NSWindow and SwiftUI.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the system's file viewer, or shows an alert if not found.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the application's configuration folder in the file viewer.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store path in the file viewer, or its containing folder.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification asynchronously.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command and handles the response asynchronously.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the local or remote gateway depending on the connection mode, managing services and connections.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel in remote mode, or reports an error if remote mode is not enabled.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file or log directory.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Performs a health check update immediately.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Requests a heartbeat event, returning the data or error.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Checks if verbose logging is enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging and notifies the control channel, returning the new state.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application by relaunching the process.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state and restarts onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the session store path from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent session data with a specified limit.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session information on the server with new thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses gateway ports and returns reports.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID, with fallback to force kill.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store in Visual Studio Code.
